book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Mataayo

content: Yɨɨsu aratʉma abhɨɨga bhaazɨ ikumi na bhabhɨrɨ
Yɨɨsu akabhɨrɨkɨra abhɨɨga bhaazɨ ikumi na bhabhɨrɨ, akabhaha ʉbhʉnaja bhu ukuruusha amasambwa amabhɨ na bhwo okohorya amarwɨrɨ gʉʉsi.
Amariina ga abhɨɨga ikumi na bhabhɨrɨ bhayo, nɨ‑ganʉ: We embere ni‑Simʉʉni wʉnʉ akubhirikirwa Peetero,
na Andureya umuhiiri waazɨ, Yaakobho umwana wa Zebhedaayo, na Yoohana umuhiiri waazɨ,
Firipʉ, Bhatoromayo, Tomaaso, Mataayo wʉnʉ aarɨ umurihya wa rigʉʉti, Yaakobho umwana wa Arifaayʉ, Tadaayo,
Simʉʉni Ʉmʉkananayʉ,
enzobhooro yaku ni‑mwitaniri wi icharʉ chazɨ, na Yuuda Isikariyʉʉti wʉnʉ iichurirɨ Yɨɨsu.
Yɨɨsu akatʉma abhɨɨga ikumi na bhabhɨrɨ bhayo, akabharaganʼya, “Mʉtaja kʉbhaatʉ bhanʉ bhatarɨ Abhayaahudi, na mʉtasikɨra rʉbhɨri rwʉrwʉsi rwa Samaariya.
Nawe mujɨ kuBhiiziraɨri, bhayo nɨ‑zɨngʼʉndu zɨnʉ zibhurirɨ.
Hanʉ mukuja kwebho, murwazɨ, ‘Ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa mwisaarʉ bhʉraariirɨ!’
Mohorye abharwɨrɨ, muryʉrɨ abhaku, mohorye bhe ebhegenge na moheebhe amasambwa. Mubhwɨnɨ ʉbhʉnaja bhuyo bhʉʉha, na niimwɨ muhuruchɨ bhʉʉha.
Na morogendo rwanyu mʉtagega ɨzahaabhu nʉʉrʉ mpirya nʉʉrʉ zishabha mʉbhɨgʉzi bhyanyu.
Mʉtabhanʉra ɨsakwa, hamwɨ ɨshadi ya kʉgarʉra, hamwɨ ibhikwɨra, hamwɨ ihimbʉ, kʉ kʉbha omohocha wʉʉsi areenderwa kʉhaabhwa amarihi.
“Ʉrʉbhɨri rwʉrwʉsi rʉnʉ mʉraasikɨrɨ, momohye ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akwisirirya kʉbhaginihya ɨwaazɨ. Mwikarɨ kwawɨ kuhika hanʉ mʉkʉbhʉʉka.
Hanʉ mukusikɨra muwaazɨ, mʉsabhɨrɨ abhaatʉ bhaazɨ omorembe.
Arɨɨbhɨ bharimu abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakwenderwa, amakeerenʼya gaanyu garabhaha omorembe. Nawe arɨɨbhɨ bhatakwenderwa kʉsʉngʼaana, omorembe guyo gʉbhagarʉkɨrɨ imwɨ abheene.
Mʉraahikɨ munyumba hamwɨ ʉrʉbhɨri rwʉrwʉsi, na abhaatʉ bhakaanga kʉbhaginihya na kubhiitegeerera, hanʉ mukurwa ahagero hayo, mʉkʉngʼʉtɨ urutu kʉmagʉrʉ gaanyu, kobheerecha kʉbha Mungu arabhaanga.
Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, urusikʉ rwɨ ɨtɨnɨrʉ, Mungu arabhaha ɨnyaakʉ bhʉkʉngʼu abhaatʉ bhʉ ʉrʉbhɨri ruyo, kʉkɨra abhaatʉ bha zɨmbɨri za Sodoma na Gomora!
Ɨnyaakʉ yɨnʉ ikuuza
“Rora, nɨrabhatʉma ncha zɨngʼʉndu gatɨ wa zisuuzɨ. Nangʉ, mʉbhɨ bhangʼɨɨni nche enzoka, na abhanyʉʉhu nchi ikiguuti.
Mwiyangarɨrɨ na abhaatʉ, kʉ kʉbha bharabhahira kuchandarʉ, na bharabhatema ɨmɨzariti mʉmarwazɨrʉ gaabhʉ.
Bharabhahira mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa abhakangati na abhatɨmi igʉrʉ waanɨ. Moreenderwa kʉbha abhamɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri bhaanɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwabhʉ na mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhatarɨ Abhayaahudi.
Hanʉ bharaabhagwatɨ, mʉtabha na makɨbhwɨ kʉbha mʉragambakɨ hamwɨ mʉragambabhwɨ. Mungu arabhaha amangʼana gʉ ʉkʉgamba kwibhaga riyo.
Ɨtarɨ kʉbha imwɨ mʉragamba, nawe ne‑Koro ya Wuusʉ neyo ɨraagambɨ kʉhɨtɨra kwa niimwɨ.
“Ribhaga riyo, umuhiiri ariichʉra umuhiiri waazɨ korereke iitwɨ. Wiisɨ ariichʉra umwana waazɨ, na abhaana bhariitanʼya abhiibhuri bhaabhʉ na kugirya bhiitwɨ.
Abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bharabhabhiihirirwa igʉrʉ waanɨ. Nawe wʉnʉ ariigumiriryɨ kuhika ɨtɨnɨrʉ, newe araasabhʉkɨ.
Mʉraakorwe kɨbhɨ mʉrʉbhɨri ororebhe, muryarɨrɨ mʉrʉbhɨri ʉrʉndɨ. Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, mʉtakʉmara emeremo janyu mʉzɨmbɨri zʉʉsi za Iziraɨri, Umwana wʉ Ʉmʉʉtʉ akɨɨrɨ kuhika.
“Umwɨga atakʉkɨra umwija waazɨ, na mbʉʉsa atakʉkɨra umuniibhi waazɨ.
Umwɨga areenderwa abhɨ nchu umwija waazɨ, na mbʉʉsa abhɨ nchu umuniibhi waazɨ. Arɨɨbhɨ inyɨ ni‑muniibhi waanyu na bharambɨrɨkɨra Bhɨɨrizɨbhuri,
nangʉ imwɨ, mʉrabhirikirwa amariina amabhɨ bhʉkʉngʼu.
Mwʉbhahɨ Mungu umwene
“Mʉtʉʉbhaha abhaatʉ bhayo, kʉ kʉbha kɨtareeho kɨnʉ kikundikiriibhwɨ, kɨkatama kuhumburwa, na kɨnʉ kibhisirwɨ, kɨkatama kororekana.
Gʉʉsi ganʉ nɨkʉbhabhʉʉrɨra imwɨ mukiirimya, mʉgagambɨ habhwɨrʉ, na gʉʉsi ganʉ mukwigwa kwa mbisi, mʉgarwazɨ kʉbhaatʉ habhwɨrʉ.
Mʉtʉʉbhaha bhanʉ bhakʉtʉra kwita ʉmʉbhɨrɨ, nawe bhatakʉnaja kwita ekoro yaanyu. Nawe mwʉbhahɨ Mungu, kʉ kʉbha newe akʉtʉra kuricha ʉmʉbhɨrɨ hamwɨmwɨ ne ekoro momorero gwa nyaari.
“Awɨɨ! Zɨsanzɨ ibhɨrɨ zɨtakuguribhwa ubhuguri ubhusuuhu? Nawe ɨtareeho naabha yɨmwɨ yɨnʉ ikugwa haasɨ iyeene, Wuusʉ atasɨɨgirɨ.
Na niimwɨ, Mungu amɨnyirɨ endengo ya zinzwɨrɨ za kumitwɨ janyu.
Mmbe, mʉtʉʉbhaha, kʉ kʉbha imwɨ munu ubhwera kʉkɨra zɨsanzɨ.
“Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ araanyiisiriryɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa abhaatʉ, na niinyɨ nɨramwisirirya mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Bhaabha wa mwisaarʉ.
Nawe, wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akʉnyanga mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa abhaatʉ, na niinyɨ nɨramwanga mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Bhaabha wa mwisaarʉ.
Yɨɨsu arɨɨtirɨ ʉbhʉtaamanʼya
“Mutiiseega kʉbha niizirɨ mʉʉsɨ koreeta omorembe. Nitiizirɨ koreeta omorembe, nawe ʉbhʉtaamanʼya.
Niizirɨ koreeta ʉbhʉtaamanʼya gatɨ wu umwana na wiisɨ, umuucha na unina, na gatɨ wʉ ʉmʉkamwana na uninabhyara.
Abhabhisa bhʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ ni‑bhu uwaazɨ.

Wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ asɨɨgirɨ wiisɨ hamwɨ unina kʉkɨra chɨmbu ansɨɨgirɨ, atakwenderwa kʉbha mʉhɨmba waanɨ. Na wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ asɨɨgirɨ umwana waazɨ hamwɨ umuucha waazɨ kʉkɨra chɨmbu ansɨɨgirɨ, wʉʉsi atakwenderwa kʉbha mʉhɨmba waanɨ.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ atakogega ʉmʉsarabha gwazɨ
na kuntuna, wuyo atakwenderwa kʉbha mʉhɨmba waanɨ.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akwenda kohonʼya ʉbhʉhʉru bhwazɨ umwene, arabhurimirya. Nawe ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akurimirya ʉbhʉhʉru bhwazɨ igʉrʉ waanɨ, arabha nʉ ʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano.
Ʉmʉbhanʉ kʉbhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakʉsʉngʼaanaabhahɨmba bha Yɨɨsu
“Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akʉbhaginihya imwɨ, aranginihya na niinyɨ. Na wʉnʉ araanginihyɨ, araginihya na wʉnʉ antumirɨ.

Wʉnʉ akuginihya ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri kʉ kʉbha nɨ‑mʉrʉʉtɨrɨri, Mungu aramʉbhanʉra ʉmʉbhanʉ ncha gwʉ ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri. Na wʉnʉ akuginihya ʉmʉʉtʉ we eheene kʉ kʉbha ne‑we eheene, aramʉbhanʉra ʉmʉbhanʉ ncha gwa we eheene.
Wʉnʉ araamohe wʉmwɨ wa abhasuuhu bhanʉ ekekombe cha amanzi amamɨɨzu kʉ kʉbha nɨ‑mʉhɨmba waanɨ, nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, atakubhurwa ʉmʉbhanʉ gwazɨ.”

footnotes.text: Simʉʉni Ʉmʉkananayʉ aarɨ na amariina abhɨrɨ, ɨrɨmwɨ ryi Ikigiriki, Simʉʉni Ʉmʉzɨrʉʉti, ɨrɨndɨ ryɨ Ɨkɨyaahudi, Simʉʉni Ʉmʉkananayʉ. Gʉʉsi gane enzobhooro yɨmwɨ, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akwitanɨra ubhwiyagaaruri bhwɨ ɨɨsɨ yaazɨ.
Sodoma na Gomora zaarɨ zɨmbɨri zɨnʉ Mungu aarikiryɨ igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwa abhaatʉ bhaaku. Rora Ʉbhʉtangɨ 19:24‑29.
Bhɨɨrizɨbhuri, ni‑riina ɨrɨndɨ rya Shɨtaani, ʉmʉkʉrʉ wa amasambwa gʉʉsi.
Kogega ʉmʉsarabha gwazɨ, enzobhooro yaku ni‑kwisirirya ɨnyaakʉ yʉyʉʉsi, nʉʉrʉ kukwa igʉrʉ wu ukutuna Yɨɨsu.
